findings.highlight: "Ahh, is that right…? I guess I've been treating everyone pretty terribly. Sorry, it's just that I had a lot going on…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「ああ、そっか…俺、付き合い悪かったよな。
ごめん、ここしばらくはちょっと…」
findings.explanation: 付き合い悪い characterizes Haruki as unavailable or unsociable, while the translation says he has been treating everyone terribly.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、そっか…俺、付き合い悪かったよな。
ごめん、ここしばらくはちょっと…」
findings.todokanai: "Ahh, is that right…? I guess I've been treating everyone pretty terribly. Sorry, it's just that I had a lot going on…"

findings.highlight: But I meant what I said.
findings.evidenceJa: でも、言っちゃったのは本当のことなの
findings.explanation: Setsuna says it is true that she said the breakup words, not that she truly meant them. The translation converts an admission of the utterance into a claim of sincere intent, changing her motive in the rejection.
findings.japanese:
「でも、言っちゃったのは本当のことなの。
なのに、なのにさ…
どうして春希くんは、そんなわたしを好きだなんて…」
findings.todokanai: "But I meant what I said. So why…? How could Haruki-kun still possibly love me…?"

findings.highlight: will never be able to forget about Kazusa
findings.evidenceJa: 春希くんは決してかずさのことを忘れなかった
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Haruki did not forget Kazusa. The translation changes this observed past fact into a permanent future inability, adding fatalism and altering the basis of Setsuna's conclusion.
findings.japanese:
「ううん、幻想だった。
春希くんは決してかずさのことを忘れなかった」
findings.todokanai: "No, it's a delusion for sure. Haruki-kun will never be able to forget about Kazusa."

findings.evidenceJa: 『やっぱり雪菜が大好きだ！』って
findings.explanation: Io quotes Haruki declaring to Io and Takeya that he loves Setsuna; Setsuna is not present. The translation turns the third-person declaration about her into direct address, falsely placing her as the addressee of the New Year's confession.
findings.japanese:
「除夜の鐘を聞きながら、俺たちの目の前でいきなり
『やっぱり雪菜が大好きだ！』って告白したくせに」
findings.todokanai: "Even though during the toll of the bell on New Year's Eve, you said, 'I still love you, Setsuna!' right in front of us."

findings.highlight: the way I'm saying this doesn't seem very friendly
findings.evidenceJa: 表現的にはとても味方してるように聞こえないけど
findings.explanation: Haruki observes that the way his two friends are expressing themselves does not sound supportive. The translation makes the issue Haruki's own manner of speaking, assigning the register judgment to the wrong speakers.
findings.japanese:
表現的にはとても味方してるように聞こえないけど、
今はそういうことを云々する場じゃない。
findings.todokanai: Though the way I'm saying this doesn't seem very friendly, now is not the time to pick on such details.

findings.highlight: "Besides… I'm the only one who can convince Setsuna right now."
findings.evidenceJa:
「それにさ…
今、雪菜を口説いていいのは俺だけだ」
findings.explanation: 口説く is woo or court romantically, while the translation uses the weaker 'convince.'
findings.japanese:
「それにさ…
今、雪菜を口説いていいのは俺だけだ」
findings.todokanai: "Besides… I'm the only one who can convince Setsuna right now."

findings.explanation: The alcohol has taken effect as the night advances; it has not run out. The translation replaces growing intoxication with depleted supplies.
findings.todokanai: It's past 2 o'clock, and we're out of booze…

findings.explanation: Takeya proposes going once spring break begins, meaning during the break. The translation schedules the outing after spring break.
findings.japanese:
「春休みに入ったらさ、
四人でどこか遊びに行かないか？」
findings.todokanai: "After spring break, how about the four of us go somewhere to hang out?"

findings.highlight: someone here would probably hate it
findings.evidenceJa: ここにいない誰かは嫌がるかもしれない
findings.explanation: Io jokes that someone not present—Setsuna—may dislike skiing. The translation says the person is here, breaking the absent-person reference.
findings.japanese:
「あ～、いいねぇ。
あたしスキーがいいな。
ここにいない誰かは嫌がるかもしれないけど」
findings.todokanai: "Aah, sounds good. I'd like to go skiing. But I imagine someone here would probably hate it."

findings.highlight: the club that was falling apart
findings.evidenceJa: メンバーにもなれないのに同好会にしがみついてた
findings.explanation: Haruki recalls clinging to the club even though he could not become a member. The translation invents a club falling apart and deletes his outsider status, which is the self-deprecating point of the recollection.
findings.japanese:
ギターを始めたのも、
作詞なんてものに興味を持ったのも、
メンバーにもなれないのに同好会にしがみついてたのも。
findings.todokanai: Back when I first started playing the guitar, or when I took an interest in writing lyrics, or when I held on and refused to let go of the club that was falling apart.

findings.highlight: it's very common for guys who take up the guitar to have a very simple and pure intention
findings.evidenceJa: 男の子がギターを始める、純粋な衝動に駆られて
findings.explanation: Haruki says that this time he is driven by the pure impulse that makes a boy take up guitar. The translation turns his renewed personal motive into a detached generalization about what is common for boys.
findings.japanese:
昔みたいに、ひねくれた理由じゃない。
男の子がギターを始める、
純粋な衝動に駆られて。
findings.todokanai: But it's not for that defiant reason from the past. In fact, it's very common for guys who take up the guitar to have a very simple and pure intention.
